mathematical_core: For a hub row sqrt(c)e and any two-bank light partition with positive transverse Grams W_S,W_T, the bank graph residuals can be orthonormalized exactly into (Z,Pi), an at-most-five-dimensional orthonormal projection of original light product coordinates.
The full longitudinal light statistic is eta.Pi with ||eta||^2=1-c exactly; no random perturbation is deleted.
At zero physical hub pivot, after deterministic transverse spectral coordinates and exact hub translation, Q=2 kappa L[X_0+m(L,V,Pi)]+lambda V^2 with kappa^2|lambda|=c|det M|>=c s^3.

For signature (2,1), lambda has positive majority sign; for (1,2), negative majority sign. The lambda V^2 term is forced by rank three and is the exact third-direction resource beyond the logarithmic saddle.
